messages:
kevin: follow-up from the authz postmortem — noticed a recurring pattern: migrations or bulk rotates that touch secrets often bypass audit middleware and also introduce TTL unit drift for token writes. we need a coordinated remediation plan, owners, and a compliance artifact flow.

marco: agree. two quick asks: (1) audit middleware must be mandatory for any rotate path, no opt-outs; (2) add a short automated verification after rotates that checks audit event counts vs rotated token counts.

tara: i'll own the writer/runtime changes. plan: normalize TTLs to seconds in the writer library, add defensive validation rejecting TTLs <10s or >30d, and add a lib-level audit event on write. will open PR and include unit + integration tests that simulate mixed-binary writes. target PR by 2026-04-05.

ops-oncall: i'll draft a condensed rotate runbook and schedule a prep call. runbook sketch: 1) run audit export to CSV; 2) group by service owner + count; 3) if count > 2000 -> automated rotate with 24h grace window; else manual targeted rotates; 4) after rotate, run verification job that compares rotated list with audit write events and produce proof artifact; 5) upload CSV + verification proof to secure storage and link to ticket. prep call tomorrow 09:00 PT.

kevin: good. add enforcement: the rotate CLI should fail if audit middleware is unreachable or returns errors. Marco, can you add that gate to the rotate tool?

marco: yep. i'll update rotate tool: if audit middleware returns non-2xx we fail with explanation and write a diagnostic dump. also will add a `--dry-run` that outputs expected audit events to be checked. PR by 2026-03-31.

tara: sample Redis audit query i'm adding to the ticket for ops to run (batched):
```
# batched TTL anomaly export + owner label (pseudo)
redis-cli --scan --pattern "auth:token:*" | xargs -n200 | while read batch; do for k in $batch; do t=$(redis-cli ttl "$k"); if [ "$t" -le 10 -o "$t" -gt 2592000 ]; then owner=$(redis-cli hget "$k" owner || echo unknown); echo "$k,$t,$owner"; fi; done; done > anomalies.csv
```
this can be adapted to our production-friendly batch runner.

ops-oncall: added calendar invite and created follow-up ticket SEC-5377  summary: normalize TTLs, enforce audit on rotate, verification & compliance proofs. owners listed below.

kevin: assigning owners & deadlines (short):
- TARA: runtime TTL normalization + lib-level audit writes + tests (due 2026-04-05)
- MARCO: rotate tool audit-gate + dry-run + verification hook (due 2026-03-31)
- OPS-ONCALL: runbook + prep call + verification job (prep call 2026-03-29)

marco: after audit CSV is produced we should also run a permission-map to detect services with high secret churn and flag them for longer-term secret hygiene work (rotate cadence, rate limits). i'll add a small script to produce a per-service churn metric.

kevin: compliance note: every automated rotate needs proof artifacts (CSV, rotate job log, audit event IDs). make sure verification job emits a signed artifact and we store it in the secure bucket.

ops-oncall: will default to a 24h grace rotate window for automated rotates and notify owners via email + slack. runbook includes commands to flip the feature flag `AUTH_TTL_STRICT=true` in staging/canary before prod. example: `kubectl set env deploy/auth-writer AUTH_TTL_STRICT=true -n prod`

marco: added CI test `ci/rotate-audit-verify` that runs a small end-to-end on a test cluster: perform a rotate, assert audit events count == rotated_count, and fail if mismatch. will land in `ci/rotations`.

tara: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4128 (includes TTL normalization, guardrails, and a lightweight audit write on token create). linking SEC-5377.

ops-oncall: initial audit run results posted in SEC-5377: ~1.8k anomalous tokens, concentrated in 3 services. prepping CSV for service owners.

kevin: good progress. final asks: (1) add one-line convention to runbook: "TTL must be written in seconds (s) across all writer binaries"; (2) include the Redis batched snippet and verification steps; (3) owners update SEC-5377 as tasks progress.

audit-bot: SEC-5377 updated  owners assigned, verification job scheduled (automated).

marco: once rotated, ops please run the verification job and share the proof artifact link here. i'll review rotate logs and the dry-run diagnostics to ensure no bypass occurred.

ops-oncall: will do. thanks everyone — let's aim to close follow-ups after the 7-day post-rotate review on 2026-04-13.
